resources.string: Switches the G9 to X-Input or DS5 when you open the apps you choose in G9 Control and opens the game panel with L3 + R3. It sees which app is on screen and the controller\'s buttons, and takes game screenshots when you ask. The window permission is only to know which window is the game and capture just that: it doesn\'t read its text or what you type, and the app doesn\'t connect to the internet.
